title: Red Hat Security Advisory: gvfs security update
description: CVE-2026-84268 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the GNOME gvfs component, specifically in the SFTP protocol handling function read_reply(). This vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 8.8, indicating it can lead to high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability. The issue affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 and related distributions. A security update addressing this vulnerability is available from Red Hat.
aiSummary: The vulnerability CVE-2026-84268 involves a heap-based buffer overflow in the read_reply() function of the SFTP implementation within GNOME gvfs. GVFS is a virtual file system layer that integrates with GNOME to provide access to local and remote file systems using various protocols including SFTP. The overflow could allow an attacker to cause a denial of service or potentially execute arbitrary code. Red Hat has issued an important security advisory (RHSA-2026:73997) providing updated gvfs packages that fix this issue.
aiImpact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could result in a complete compromise of the affected system's confidentiality, integrity, and availability due to the heap-based buffer overflow. The CVSS score of 8.8 reflects the potential for remote exploitation without privileges and user interaction, leading to high impact on the system.
